title: Globally filtered long code instance
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let $T$ be a sign tester with a finite seed set and a probability law, and let $\Psi$ be a finite set of sign predicates used by every check selected by $T$. Let $R$ be a uniform refinement of the resulting allowed long code weighted experiment. Given natural numbers $r,M$ with $r\le M$, and assuming every check selected by a seed has predicate arity at most $r$, the globally filtered long code CSP is the globally filtered clone CSP of that experiment and refinement.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game $G$ with alphabet size $q$
